comments.value: i agree with this option. the quick menu wings friends option allows us to join/req/invite or invite our friends to our instance which is great but we still cannot see information about our friends lobby if when they are green or blue and not in a private instance. being on vrc for a while taught me i should just blindly join somebody which reverts me to using the full layout. i really enjoy the wings as it allows me to use the menu while laying down.
Yeah tbh it would be fine if the QM would just stay in the here tab (aka the tab I had open the last time) instead of always switch back to the Launch Pad when reopening it.
We're at 100 upvotes. Though I found the Here tab more suitable since launch. I'll leave this thread open for discussion.
The 'Here' tab has been suitable since launch. I like using it.

We've added the "Friends Location" category in the MM Social page which is also present in the wings. This works just like ~GuiGui~ mentioned: You can now see friends locations in your wings if they're on green/blue status, including any instance you're on with them.
DAG-XR: what you mention sounds like the "Here" tab in the QM correct? You can scroll through all the users in your instance there!
@{628d00a6b624bb0b622328ef|full_name}: Yeah this is for the Here/In current room tab, but as a wing. Not for friends

@{5b7efd0f2929584072ccb6ff|full_name}: Hmm, in order to see the wings you must first open the QM, on which the "Here" tab is already present. Is there something missing from that tab that you think the wing could improve?

@{628d00a6b624bb0b622328ef|full_name}: Thanks for checking back in. I'm surprised this has as many upvotes as it does. I have since commented that the Here tab does an accurate job in the Quick Menu as what I described on the original post. During the time I posted, I was still used to the old Main Menu social tab.
I suppose the only good use for an "In Room" tab on the QM wing, would be for people who like to manage events and keep a smaller version of the Here tab available every time they open up the menu.
I no longer think that this would be necessary to implement, but I would use this wing if it was an option.

Re-visiting this thread. Having In Room users on a Wing to have on the side may prove useful if you're hosting a Group+ or a Group Public instance to moderate, and you can continue to use your Quick Menu while it's open on other tabs.

Again, while the Here tab proves useful, having another option may also work for other users, depending on preference.

I would love to see in the quick menu wing an Option called "Here" or "in instance" with a list of players in this instance. Or an option to open the Quick menu with the "Here" page open, when you moderate an instance it gets annoying to always have to open the page again or go into the big menu to look at in instance.
Seems like this is already in-game

details: The ability to show online friends is good, but I also like the idea of wanting to quickly scroll through users who are currently in the room.
title: [1137] Add "In Room" users to Wing options.

voters.name: S a c r e d
